name: Research Communication and Ethics
description: The course will have some interactive sessions on topics such as role of research communication in advancing and dissemination of knowledge, principles of effective communication, communication channels, research writing (scientific papers, research proposals, project reports etc.), oral presentations on research, presentation skills and different types of audiences, data visualization and presentation, and public engagement. The course will also have practical exercises and assignments on writing scientific papers and reviews on published literature, and oral presentations on suitable topics. The course will also help in navigating ethics, community sovereignty, and data integrity
